exact_statement.statement: On CelebA negation, LoGDiff has FID 23.61 versus 32.87 for constant mixing, while AND and OR-CI conformity remains comparable.
exact_statement.domain: CelebA Blond/Non-blond and Male/Female attributes; AND, NOT, and OR-CI tasks.
exact_statement.quantifiers: For every task and method, generate 5000 samples as 50 queries with 100 images each and evaluate FID with clean-fid.

routes.name: exact author-release executability audit
routes.interpretation: Require the three checkpoint paths and exact clean-fid/sample protocol declared by the paper and release.
routes.method: Hash and enumerate the pinned 73-file author tree, resolve every config reference, and compare the executable evaluator against Appendix E.2.
commands: uv sync --frozen && uv run python repro/src/run_logdiff.py --output-dir .openresearch/artifacts --seeds 25
routes.result: All three checkpoints are absent, the requested dataset config is absent, and the released evaluator uses TorchMetrics FID with inconsistent sample accounting rather than the paper's clean-fid protocol.
routes.control: A synthetic complete release with all paths and the clean-fid protocol reaches READY_TO_RUN.

routes.name: public author-checkpoint provenance search
routes.interpretation: Treat a checkpoint as author-equivalent only if its provenance resolves to the author release, declared filenames, or author account.
routes.method: Query official repository branches, tags, releases, and forks, then Hugging Face models, datasets, and Spaces for the author, project title, and exact checkpoint stems.
routes.result: The official repository has one branch and no tags, releases, or forks. Author and exact-filename Hugging Face searches return no model, dataset, or Space. One dataset returned for generic LogDiff is an unrelated preference dataset and is rejected.
routes.control: The same APIs resolve the official main branch and the independent public CelebA model used in route 3.

routes.name: independent public-model protocol reconstruction audit
routes.interpretation: Test whether a public CelebA diffusion checkpoint can supply an exact executable equivalent even when the author weights are missing.
routes.method: Resolve shalpin87/diffusion_celeba at its pinned revision and inspect its complete model tree and roles against the LoGDiff diffusion, composition-classifier, and independent-judge requirements.
routes.result: The public revision resolves and exposes a 114,049,969-byte Diffusers UNet, but it contains neither the paper's SiT diffusion state nor the LoGDiff composition and judge classifiers. It can support a proxy study only, not the exact claim.
routes.control: The route positively resolves revision 91d0ff096e031c21b8313bd5877316a52900d4ec and its UNet blob while role matching rejects the missing LoGDiff states.

routes.name: assumption-satisfying falsification search
routes.interpretation: A falsification requires an exact-method 5000-image-per-task campaign using the stated attributes, queries, and clean-fid; missing weights or a proxy model cannot count.
routes.method: Restate the exact domain and quantifiers, audit Table 3 for a transcription contradiction, and test whether any recovered or public run is admissible as a counterexample.
routes.result: The quoted 23.61 and 32.87 values match Table 3. No exact-method image set or clean-fid output is recoverable. The public DDPM is not author-equivalent, so falsification did not succeed.
routes.control: A synthetic exact-protocol result with LoGDiff FID 35 and constant FID 30 is detected as a reversal; the paper table is not.

unblockers: The three author-equivalent CelebA checkpoints with provenance.
The exact dataset config and a clean-fid implementation matching Appendix E.2.
Raw 5000-image-per-task outputs or a fully executable exact-protocol campaign with independent conformity and FID checks.
